title: The Chained Angel
text: Something with burned wings is chained to the shrine's altar with iron links as thick as a wrist. Its feathers have fallen around it like ash, and the stone beneath it is scorched in the shape of its body. It is still alive. It watches you approach but asks for nothing.

options.label: The most devout breaks its chains, believing nothing holy should be bound like a beast.

outcomes.text: The chains fall away. It follows you home on ruined wings, though no one can say what it will become.
As the chains fall away it vanishes in a burst of light. Far off, something else has taken notice of what you did.

options.label: End it, while it still asks for nothing and before it can ask for something.

outcomes.text: It does not resist. What remains is a heap of holy ash, which you gather in silence, unable to meet one another's eyes.

options.label: Leave it chained, and leave quickly. Someone bound it here for a reason.

outcomes.text: It watches you go without a word of reproach. That silence follows you for the rest of the day.
